Fieldwork & Site Visits

Participated in a technical site visitation organized by the Nigerian Institution of Civil Engineers (Student Affiliate, Southwest Division), providing hands-on exposure to large-scale infrastructure delivery, construction practices, and project management within a real-world civil engineering project environment — the 110-kilometer Senator Rashidi Ladoja Circular Road in Ibadan. Also attended a Nigerian Society of Engineers (NSE) monthly seminar focused on continuous professional development, industry best practices, and engagement with practicing engineers to strengthen technical competence and professional ethics, and a technical site visitation to the Eleyele Water Works, observing water treatment infrastructure and operations in a live municipal engineering setting.
